metadata.description: Design systems for AZMX and its brands, packaged as Agent Skills. One plugin per skill, each from its own repository.

plugins.name: azmx-brand
plugins.description: The AZMX brand and communication system. Colors, design tokens, typography, logos, fonts, the email design system, voice and tone, the PDF form pipeline, the unified communication strategy.

plugins.name: colab-design
plugins.description: The Colab design system. Palette with verified contrast rules, type scale, the 8-column slide grid, 14 layout archetypes, the pixel and dither graphic language, the four-ground token system, EN/AR build rules.

plugins.name: majarah-design
plugins.description: The Majarah design system. Eleven-variable palette with a measured contrast matrix, the Oswald/Helvetica type system, the 1920x1080 slide grid, twelve layout archetypes, the EN/AR variable architecture.
